name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual non-disclosure agreement, allowing each party to disclose confidential information for an agreed purpose. Pair with mutual-nda-coverpage.md.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page that captures the deal-specific terms (parties, purpose, effective date) that incorporate the Mutual NDA standard terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a SaaS/cloud service agreement covering access and use of the service, support, user accounts, feedback and usage data, and customer content.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining uptime targets, uptime calculation methodology, and support response time commitments for a cloud service.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard terms governing the processing of personal data between a controller and processor (or processor and subprocessor), including data protection obligations.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard terms for an early-access design partner program, covering product access, feedback obligations, and fees.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for professional services engagements delivered under one or more statements of work, covering services, cooperation, change orders, acceptance, and subcontractors.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership arrangement covering each party's obligations, payment and taxes, and feedback.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard HIPAA business associate terms governing a provider's permitted uses and disclosures of protected health information (PHI) and required safeguards.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for an on-premises or self-hosted software license, covering license grant, user accounts, feedback and usage data, machine learning use, and open source software.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard terms for a time-limited product pilot or evaluation, covering access, license, user accounts, customer content, feedback, and usage data during the pilot period.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard addendum supplementing a Common Paper agreement with terms specific to AI services, including use of input/output, restrictions, and model training.
